label: PF Backlog 587
title: EPIC: Generation Proportionality - artifact contract + project profile drive generation (bounded by construction)
body:
## Problem / why
The Artifact Contract Registry (BI-PF-1342) mapped every agent/stage to a contract and validates output against it, but generation does NOT consume the contract: agent prompts hardcode big templates (design 3.1-3.10, architect 6.1-6.21), generation sections come from config/agent-requirements.json, and the project-size profile (small/medium/large) is never passed to resolve(). Result: design/architect over-produce (BI-PF-1333: 19 FRs + 15 NFRs + 13 user stories + 314KB partial for ONE trivial feature; ~140k tokens / 11 calls) and calls run long/costly. Three independent section sources (prompt template vs agent-requirements.json vs artifact-contract) drift.
## Goal & value
Bounded by construction: ONE lever (artifact contract x project-size profile x kind) drives each agent's section plan, counts and size; the agent prompt/section plan is derived from it; output stays proportionate for simple vs medium vs large/complex projects - no arbitrary per-agent caps.
## In scope
- Contract + profile -> generation (section plan; resolve(profile); new Go op artifact_contracts.generation_plan)
- Profile lever: required vs optional sections + counts bands + size budget (small/medium/large)
- Contract-driven prompts; deprecate the hardcoded design/architect templates; framework-agnostic (remove .opencode refs)
- Enforce per-feature FR/US caps + max_lines (scaled by the profile)
- Single source for sections (reconcile the three sources)
## Out of scope
- EDP data-plane; per-agent model selection; the state-sync/backlog-area items
## Acceptance criteria
- Generation consumes the resolved artifact contract (required sections always; optional per profile); no hardcoded template duplication remains.
- A trivial (small-profile) project yields the required-only section set within budget; larger profiles add optional sections/counts - all from the one profile lever.
- No .opencode references in agent prompts.
- BI-PF-1333 verified on MyToDo and closed.

analysis.implementation_strategy: SINGLE SOURCE FOR GENERATION = resolve(agent, stage, kind, profile) from config/artifact-contracts/ (index.json contracts + agents.json map + profiles.json). Align the THREE current section sources to it: (1) agents/*.agent.json `instructions` hardcoded templates (design.md 3.1-3.10; architect 6.1-6.21 NFR tables) -> become contract-driven; (2) config/agent-requirements.json `required_sections` (the CURRENT generation section list; agent_runner.py:948-952 `spec = required_sections(agent_id)`) -> reconcile to the contract or deprecate; (3) config/artifact-contracts (sections/required_sections/counts/size) + profiles.json -> THE source. PROFILE LEVER: profiles.json small/medium/large (size_multiplier+depth) extended to select required-vs-optional sections + counts bands + size; the project profile (project.json) is passed into resolve() so the lever actually bites (today resolve is called WITHOUT profile at agent_runner.py:913 and stage_runner.py:105 -> always medium). WIRING: new Go op artifact_contracts.generation_plan (go/pfcore/artifact_contracts.go) returns the per-agent section plan for a profile (required always; optional per profile; counts bands; size budget); core/contracts.py thin client; core/orchestrator/agent_runner._generate_sectioned consumes the plan for `ordered`/per-feature; stage_runner passes the profile; enforce via PIPELINE_ARTIFACT_VALIDATION.
